title: Complete small-input threshold decomposition benchmark
build: Rust release opt-level3 thinLTO; SymJIT O2; Horner10; CPE1000; symbolic Taylor endpoints

protocol.seeds: base202610111701/2 +1000*level; independent levels, shared across matched arms

limitations: No no-contour ggHH or general resolver claim
SE is native estimated-mean standard deviation; no raw-QMC sample SD reconstructed
Shared seeds do not supply cross-arm covariance/significance
Peak RSS is the maximum of independent native and external aggregate RSS observations, not exact high-water or unique resident pages; absent samples are null
Original external observer duration includes delayed polling/closure and is not process wall time; timing-only successor measurements will be separate
Native elapsed_seconds is integration-driver wall time including initialization/checkpoint work, separate from load/pilot and not pure sampling
Maximum sector mean cost is not maximum individual-point latency
Two seed families are descriptive; no strong timing advantage inferred

reference.scope: native rGamma-normalized B0; no independent epsilon-one reference

execution.wall_clock: monotonic launch through dedicated wait-thread process completion
execution.scope: timing-only repeat; sampled aggregate parent+descendant RSS, shared pages counted per process; exhaustive closure scan excluded from process wall
